value.rationale: The exact inverse-fiber count as a function of finite ring size is a natural invariant of the recently established non-bipermutive LEO cellular automaton. The sharp alternating target lift from spatial period 2 to period 16, with no preimage on shorter cyclic rings and exactly eight on every multiple of sixteen, exposes a genuine finite-volume arithmetic obstruction not implied by bi-infinite eight-to-one behavior. Complementary homogeneous-output mod-six counts distinguish natural target classes. It is neither a generic algorithm nor arbitrary unmotivated slice.
